review_description: Ryan and his team did an outstanding job on our system. Not only was he the cheapest but also the most professional and most honest in what system I should have installed in relation to my families usage. No upselling, just 100 percent quality workmanship and professional service. Would recommend Global Solar to absolutely everyone. Don’t go anywhere else you will regret itThe install went great with the whole system being installed in a day. The team were very professional and hard working.Customer service after the install has been outstanding with Ryan sitting down with me the next day ensuring my app was working correctly. He even got drone shots for me.

The quote process was very smooth with regular contact and feedback that was incorporated into the system.  I did my research on solar and I was very fussy with the components that were being installed and how they were installed.  I opted for mid level panels to an inverter to racking system.I am a very fussy customer and was concerned about the installation and the aesthetic. I am very happy to say I am very pleased with the outcome.  The installers were very clean in executing their work and cleaning up after themselves.Thank you very much, I am now set up to reap the benefits of solar.

The salesman Mark was easy to talk to, taking time to explain the ins and outs of Solar systems. He used Finns charts, which I had studied before hand. Mark is clearly passionate about Solar. I felt the quote was very good for the top quality panels and inverters I chose. Installation was booked in within a very good time frame. The installers were polite and worked quickly and efficiently. My inverters are linked to Enphase so I can see on their app how well my panels are working anytime. Very happy with my choice.
They were very helpful and they were a local service.
